```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, cache = T)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
### Packages ###
library(tidymodels)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)
library(doParallel)
library(vip)

cl <- makeCluster(parallel::detectCores() -1)
registerDoParallel(cl)
```


```{r}
## Chargement du jeu de données
d <- read.delim("data/spam.txt", sep = " ")

## Codage de la variable SPAM en factor.
d$SPAM <- factor(d$SPAM, levels = c("0","1"))
dim(d)
head(d)
levels(d$SPAM)
```

```{r}
## Data spliting
set.seed(123)
spam_split <- initial_split(d, strata = SPAM)
spam_train <- training(spam_split)
spam_test <- testing(spam_split)
```


```{r}
# RECETTES
## Recette simple
rec_simple <- recipe(SPAM~., data = spam_train) 
## Normalisation
rec_norm <- rec_simple |>
  step_normalize(all_predictors())
## Reduction de dimension
rec_pca <- rec_norm |>
  step_pca(all_predictors(), num_comp = 10)
# Transformation 
rec_trans <- rec_norm |>
  step_YeoJohnson(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.7)|>
  step_poly(all_numeric_predictors(), degree = 2)

## Models
# Forêts aléatoires 
model_rf <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), trees =500, min_n = tune())|>
  set_engine("randomForest")|>
  set_mode("classification")
# Knn
model_knn <- nearest_neighbor(neighbors = tune())|>
  set_engine("kknn")|>
  set_mode("classification")
# Arbres boostés
model_xgb <- boost_tree(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), learn_rate = tune(), 
                        tree_depth = tune(), trees = tune()) |> 
  set_engine("xgboost") |>
  set_mode("classification")
# PMC
model_nn <- mlp(
  hidden_units = tune(), penalty = tune(), epochs = tune()) |>
  set_engine("nnet") |>
  set_mode("classification")
```

```{r}
## Mise en place du workflowset
wf_set <- workflow_set(
  preproc = list(No = rec_simple, Norm = rec_norm, 
                 Pca=rec_pca, Trans = rec_trans),
   models = list(randForest = model_rf,knn= model_knn,
                Xgboost = model_xgb, mlp=model_nn), 
  cross = T)

wf_set  
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
blocs_spam <- vfold_cv(spam_train, v=10, repeats = 1, strata = SPAM)
```


```{r}
## Entrainement du workflowset
model_fit <- wf_set |>
  workflow_map("tune_grid", seed = 123, resamples = blocs_spam, grid=15, 
               metrics =metric_set(roc_auc), 
               control = control_grid(save_pred = T, save_workflow = T,
               parallel_over = "everything"),verbose = T)
```

```{r}
# Classement des différents modèles
rank_results(model_fit, select_best = T)|> select(1:6)|>
  slice(1:10)
```

```{r}
# Renommer les id pour meilleure affichage
model_fit <- model_fit |>
  mutate(
    wflow_id = case_when(
      wflow_id=="No_Xgboost"~"No_xgb",
      wflow_id=="Norm_Xgboost"~"Norm_xgb",
      wflow_id=="Trans_Xgboost"~"Trans_xgb",
      wflow_id=="Pca_Xgboost"~"Pca_xgb",
      wflow_id=="No_randForest"~"No_rf",
      wflow_id=="Norm_randForest"~"Norm_rf",
      wflow_id=="Trans_randForest"~"Trans_rf",
      wflow_id =="Pca_randForest"~"Pca_rf",
      TRUE ~ wflow_id
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Graphique pour le classement des meilleurs workflows
plot1 <- autoplot(model_fit, select_best = T)+
  geom_text(aes(y=mean - 0.01, label = wflow_id), angle=90, hjust=1)+
  theme(legend.position = "none", text = element_text(size=14))+
  ylim(c(0.939, 1))

#ggsave("modperf.pdf", width = 6, height = 4.5, units="in", device = cairo_pdf)
```



```{r}
model_fit |> 
  extract_workflow_set_result(id = "No_xgb") |>
  show_best(metric="roc_auc") |>
  select(1:6)
```

```{r}
# Extraction combinaisons optimales
best_tune <- model_fit |> 
  extract_workflow_set_result(id = "No_xgb") |>
  select_best(metric="roc_auc")
```

```{r}
collect_notes(model_fit)
```

```{r}
#Extraction du meilleur workflow
final_workflow <-  model_fit |> extract_workflow(id = "No_xgb")
# Mise à jour du workflow
final_workflow2 <- final_workflow |>finalize_workflow(best_tune)
final_workflow2
```


```{r}
# Evaluation sur le test set
final_fit <- final_workflow2 |>
  last_fit(split = spam_split)

collect_metrics(final_fit)
```


```{r}
pred_test <- collect_predictions(final_fit)
pred_test |>head()

pred_test |> conf_mat(SPAM, .pred_class) |>autoplot(type="heatmap")
```
```{r}
pred_test |>roc_curve(SPAM, .pred_1, event_level = "second")|>autoplot()
```
```{r}
extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)|>vip()
```
